reviews.title: Great app
reviews.text: Despite giving the app a good review, it keeps coming up for more reviews. Extremely annoying.

reviews.title: Looks like a scam
reviews.text: App Store says $29.99 annual plan but only option I had was weekly!?!   When I tap support it takes me to a website to download and pay for another app.  NO support !

reviews.title: Was great

reviews.title: Expensive for no reason.
reviews.text: Yeah, great app, but for the money- I dont feel like it’s worth it. $40/yr is crazy.     ???? No way.

reviews.title: Hard to Customize
reviews.text: For a first-time user, I found the app difficult to navigate when trying to customize my text graphic.
